title: On the Information-Theoretic Limits of Latent-Space Watermarking Through Pretrained Generators
abstract: arXiv:2609.24377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study latent-space watermarking through a pretrained generator using a prescribed latent-to-output stochastic mapping, called the renderer. A watermark encoder selects the latent input using a message and secret key. For every message and semantic context, the released output must have exactly the desired conditional output distribution. For finite alphabets, we derive rate--key inner and outer bounds and characterize the coding and coordination requirements for realizing watermark communication through the prescribed latent interface. When the target output distribution of the generator uniquely determines the corresponding latent input distribution through the renderer, a strengthened converse yields the capacity region; the same region governs explicit preservation of the pretrained latent distribution. translated_title: 论通过预训练生成器进行潜空间水印的信息论极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究通过预训练生成器进行潜空间水印的问题，其中使用一个规定的从潜变量到输出的随机映射，称为渲染器。水印编码器利用消息和密钥来选择潜变量输入。对于每个消息和语义上下文，发布的输出必须精确具有所需的条件输出分布。对于有限字母表，我们推导了速率-密钥的内界和外界，并刻画了通过规定的潜变量接口实现水印通信所需的编码与协调要求。当生成器的目标输出分布通过渲染器唯一地确定相应的潜变量输入分布时，一个加强的逆定理给出了容量区域；同一区域也支配着预训练潜变量分布的显式保持。我们将分析扩展到一般的联合高斯模型，并识别出潜变量的一个充分统计量，该统计量同时捕获了……
tldr: 本文建立了通过预训练生成器进行潜空间水印的信息论极限，推导了速率-密钥的内外界，并在目标输出分布唯一确定潜变量分布的条件下给出了容量区域，同时将分析扩展到联合高斯模型。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the information-theoretic limits of latent-space watermarking through pretrained generators, deriving rate-key inner and outer bounds and characterizing the capacity region when the target output distribution uniquely determines the latent input distribution, with extensions to jointly Gaussian models.
